response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT maj.department, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY maj.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL major.department form one department group, as in SQL GROUP BY.

alternatives.interpretation: Only named departments count; exclude rows where major.department is NULL.
